Because the gale height is fixed at intake and entered in the ridge receipt, the delta audit and the replay can prove which state the answer was judged against. Answers are graded against a checkpoint at least 117 seconds old, so a submission cannot be scored against state it just changed itself. That is 26 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
